CustomField.description: When the work was created in the system it came from - Jira fields.created, Asana created_at - not when this record was created. CreatedDate would read the day of the org move on every card afterwards. Written by inbound sync whenever a delivery carries it, never cleared, never pushed.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: When this was created in the source system. Synced; not editable.
CustomField.label: Source Created
